body:
Peter Bell (bell@pantheon.yale.edu) wrote:

: JobNet Manager <jobapplicat@usa.net> wrote:

: > ~ By sending your cover letter and resume direct to 
: > hiring managers and professionals, exposure of your 
: > skills will be dramatically increased.

: Oh, what a *wise* thing to post to alt.fan.unabomber, you idiot
: spammers.  Oh yeah, this is the kind of newsgroup you want to advertise
: management addresses in.  

: Do any of these clowns bother to read where they're posting?  

Hey, don't knock it. I got an e-mail recently from one of these companies,
containing the resume of a fellow in Arizona who wanted to work for me.

Not that the guy had a chance in hell of working for me -- I'd have to
have a real job *myself*, first.

Probably even got my e-mail address from alt.fan.unabomber, too.
